Content.SourceString: 异象管理局禁制机动队，四队副队长，翳。
Content.LocalizedString: Bureau of Anomaly Control, Enforcement Tactical Division, Squad 4, Lieutenant, Skia.

Content.SourceString: 幸会。
Content.LocalizedString: Pleasure to meet you.

Content.SourceString: 您好，翳先生。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, Skia.

Content.SourceString: 幸会幸会。
Content.LocalizedString: Pleasure to meet you too.

Content.SourceString: E.T.D在管理局的职责范畴，以高危、高等级异象的泯除和收容工作为主。
Content.LocalizedString: ETD's responsibilities within the Bureau primarily focus on the nullification and containment of high-risk, high-level anomalies.

Content.SourceString: 有时也会负责一些棘手的异能者罪犯。
Content.LocalizedString: We also sometimes handle troublesome Esper criminals.

OptionText.SourceString: 怎么突然开始说明工作了？

Content.SourceString: 翳先生，怎么突然开始说明工作内容了……？
Content.LocalizedString: Skia, why the sudden explanation of your job duties…?

Content.SourceString: 我认为现代社会开展沟通的基本是，双方要了解彼此的职务和所处立场。
Content.LocalizedString: I believe the foundation of communication in modern society is that both parties should understand each other's roles and positions.

Content.SourceString: 况且，得知你失去了记忆，我担忧你是否还对当时的状况抱有疑问……
Content.LocalizedString: Moreover, knowing that you've lost your memory, I was concerned you might still have questions about what happened back then…

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，会让你觉得太拘谨了吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, is this too formal?

Content.SourceString: 只是在社交软件上聊聊天，感觉会不会太正式了？
Content.LocalizedString: We're just chatting on a social app… isn't this a bit too formal?

Content.SourceString: 没关系，只是有点诧异！
Content.LocalizedString: It's okay, just a little surprised!

Content.SourceString: 看翳先生讲起E.T.D的职责范畴，一下感觉好有压力……
Content.LocalizedString: Hearing Skia explain ETD's scope of responsibilities suddenly made me feel so much pressure…

Content.SourceString: 还以为加到了业务经理之类的人物……起手就是介绍产品……
Content.LocalizedString: I thought I'd added some kind of business manager… who'd jump straight into a product pitch…

Content.SourceString: 是我的疏忽。
Content.LocalizedString: That's my oversight.

Content.SourceString: ……刚刚我的说辞看起来像是那样吗？
Content.LocalizedString: …Did what I just said really sound like that?

Content.SourceString: 当做是老毛病犯了吧，谢谢你及时打断我。
Content.LocalizedString: Consider it an old habit acting up. Thanks for stopping me in time.

Content.SourceString: 我本考虑的是，进行一番尽可能详细的解释或许更妥当……
Content.LocalizedString: I was thinking that providing as detailed an explanation as possible might be more appropriate…

Content.SourceString: J.T.F、C.S.U、E.T.D三个部门的负责范畴区分，我略有了解。
Content.LocalizedString: I have some understanding of how the responsibilities are divided between the three departments: JTF, CSU, and ETD.

Content.SourceString: 是的。

Content.SourceString: ……可是实际上，现在，我自我感觉其实已经是相当放松的状态。
Content.LocalizedString: …But actually, right now, I feel like I'm already quite relaxed.

Content.SourceString: 哈哈……是工作狂啊……

Content.SourceString: 并非只有我们。
Content.LocalizedString: It's not just us.

Content.SourceString: J.T.F和C.S.U的同事们分担了大量的救援工作，才得以让我们专注于镇压异象。
Content.LocalizedString: Our colleagues from JTF and CSU handle the bulk of the rescue operations, which allows us to focus on taking care of anomalies.

Content.SourceString: 身处什么位置，相应地去做什么事情罢了。
Content.LocalizedString: It's simply a matter of doing what needs to be done based on where you're positioned.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，职责范畴的划分是有道理的。
Content.LocalizedString: I see, so there's good reason behind how the responsibilities are divided.

Content.SourceString: 算起来，似乎已经很久没有添加局里同事之外的联系人了……
Content.LocalizedString: Come to think of it, it's been quite a while since I've added any contacts outside of my colleagues at the Bureau…

Content.SourceString: 可能会有说明不周的部分。有疑问的话，随时沟通。
Content.LocalizedString: There might be parts I didn't explain thoroughly. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out anytime.

Content.SourceString: 如果有机会取得合作，就请多关照了。
Content.LocalizedString: If we have the opportunity to work together, I look forward to your cooperation.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I'll be counting on your support

Content.LocalizedString: I wanted to consult with you about the meaning of this image. After drafting my message, I intended to attach the picture, but accidentally sent it on its own instead.

Content.SourceString: 虽然能够辨认出，这是咻啪的卡通形象，应该是想传达愉快、积极的信息……
Content.LocalizedString: While I can recognize that it's a Chuppa cartoon character, and it's probably meant to convey cheerful, positive info…

Content.SourceString: 但实际看到它的时候，尤其是在工作的场合，实在是有些费解。
Content.LocalizedString: But when I actually see it, especially in work situations, it's quite puzzling to me.

Content.SourceString: 仔细回想，我身边方便询问此事的人，也只有鉴定师了。
Content.LocalizedString: Now that I think about it, the only person around me who I can conveniently ask about this would be the Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，的确需要结合情境和话题，才能作出严谨的推断。
Content.LocalizedString: I see. Indeed, you need to consider the situation and topic to make a proper assessment.

Content.LocalizedString: Baicang.

Content.LocalizedString: Yesterday he missed another important meeting. After I attended in his place and sent him a message telling him not to let it happen again, he sent me this.

Again…?

Content.LocalizedString: What do you think this means?

Content.LocalizedString: It could mean "You caught me, but I'll do it again!"…

Content.SourceString: 有可能是「小事而已，就放过我啦~」的意思……
Content.LocalizedString: It could mean "It's no big deal, just let it slide!"…

Content.SourceString: 有可能是「我很可爱，请不要追究」的意思……
Content.LocalizedString: It could mean "I'm so cute, don't be mad!"…

Content.SourceString: ……真是生动到令人窝火。
Content.LocalizedString: That's rather accurate and infuriating.

Content.SourceString: 工作无小事。如果他是想向我表明这个态度，那我得好好和他谈一次话。
Content.LocalizedString: No matter is too small when it comes to work. If he's trying to show me that kind of attitude, then I need to have a serious talk with him.

Content.SourceString: 那还真是匪夷所思。
Content.LocalizedString: That's baffling.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师，非常合理的推断。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser. That's a very reasonable assessment.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: ……不，我还是不理解。
Content.LocalizedString: No, I still don't understand.

Content.SourceString: 也不能直接下判断！他也有可能只是单纯地喜欢这张表情……
Content.LocalizedString: You can't just jump to conclusions! He might simply like that…

Content.SourceString: 有时候，为了活跃聊天的氛围，很多人会在发消息之后随便附一张有趣的表情，但图文并不相关。
Content.LocalizedString: Sometimes to vibe up the chat, people just randomly attach something fun after sending a message, but the image and text aren't actually related.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，难怪有时候我看不懂一些新同事的消息。
Content.LocalizedString: I see, that explains why I sometimes can't understand some of my young colleagues' messages.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你的解答，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 翳先生从来不发吗？
Content.LocalizedString: You never send them?

Content.SourceString: 我参加工作时，主要通过邮件进行线上沟通，久而久之形成了习惯，因此不太熟悉新软件的功能。
Content.LocalizedString: When I started working, I mainly communicated online through email, and over time it became a habit. So I'm not very familiar with the features of newer software.

Content.SourceString: 加上我的交流内容主要是工作相关，用这类表情可能会传达不准确的信息或情绪，所以我会尽量避免。
Content.LocalizedString: Plus, since my communication is mainly work-related, using those kinds of images might convey inaccurate info or emotions, so I try to avoid them.

OptionText.SourceString: 翳先生的聊天风格很正式
OptionText.LocalizedString: Your chat style is very formal.

Content.SourceString: 翳先生的聊天风格很正式，会稍微有点让人紧张。
Content.LocalizedString: Your chat style is very formal. It can be a little intimidating.

Content.SourceString: 的确有不少同事反馈过，在和我沟通时会感觉措辞形式过于严肃……
Content.LocalizedString: Indeed, quite a few colleagues have given me feedback that they find my wording too serious when communicating with me…

Content.SourceString: 尤其提到，觉得我每条消息的标点符号都很规范，让他们也跟着紧张起来。
Content.LocalizedString: They specifically mentioned that they feel my punctuation is so proper in every message that it makes them nervous too.

Content.SourceString: 我倒是能理解这种想法。每次和翳先生聊天的时候，我也会不自觉地考虑起措辞和标点……
Content.LocalizedString: I can definitely understand that feeling. Every time I chat with you, Skia, I also find myself unconsciously thinking about my wording and punctuation…

Content.SourceString: 我倒是觉得还好。
Content.LocalizedString: I actually think it's fine.

Content.SourceString: 希望我没有让你感到拘束。
Content.LocalizedString: I hope I haven't made you feel uncomfortable.

Content.SourceString: 那就好。希望我没有让你感到拘束。
Content.LocalizedString: That's good to hear. I hope I haven't made you feel uncomfortable.

Content.SourceString: 其实，我并非想去营造严肃的气氛，只是想让每句话都能传递完整的信息，并在格式和标点上表达尊重。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not trying to create a serious atmosphere. I just want every message to convey complete information and show respect through proper formatting and punctuation.

Content.SourceString: 时间一久，我也慢慢有些忘记怎么「轻松」地聊天了……即使此刻的我确实很轻松愉快。
Content.LocalizedString: Over time, I've gradually forgotten how to chat casually… even though I truly feel relaxed and happy right now.

OptionText.LocalizedString: You can chat with me more often!
Staying like this is pretty good too!

Content.SourceString: 不介意的话，翳先生可以多和我聊天，找找感觉！
Content.LocalizedString: If you don't mind, you could chat with me more to get back into the swing of things!

Content.SourceString: 翳先生保持自己的风格就好，如果强行让自己看上去很松弛，恐怕反而会让人不自在……
Content.LocalizedString: You should just keep your own style. If you force yourself to seem relaxed, it might actually make people feel uncomfortable instead…

Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 希望你能度过愉快的一天 :-）
Content.LocalizedString: I hope you have a wonderful day :-)

Content.SourceString: 久疏问候，鉴定师。
Content.LocalizedString: It's been too long since we last spoke, Appraiser.

Content.LocalizedString: How have you been lately?

Content.LocalizedString: And how is work going?

Content.LocalizedString: Going well.

Content.LocalizedString: Is there something you need?

Content.SourceString: 无他，只是刚才被安魂曲提醒，来问候一下鉴定师，聊聊近况。
Content.LocalizedString: Nothing in particular. Lacrimosa just reminded me to check in on you and catch up a bit.

Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa reminded you to check on me?

Content.LocalizedString: But… I never would have expected it to be Lacrimosa's idea.

Content.SourceString: 我很理解你的感受。
Content.LocalizedString: Yeah.

Content.SourceString: 我常提醒她，多和来之不易的朋友交流，了解彼此。
Content.LocalizedString: I often remind her to communicate more with the friends she's worked so hard to make, and to get to know each other better.

Content.SourceString: 今天出勤的时候，反而被她问了一句，最近有没有和你问好。
Content.LocalizedString: When I was heading out for duty today, she actually asked me if I'd been checking in on you lately.

Content.SourceString: 虽然我是本着尽量避免打扰你工作的想法，避免频繁联络，但仔细一想，在这方面，我着实有所欠缺。
Content.LocalizedString: While I've been trying to avoid frequent contact so I wouldn't disturb your work, when I really think about it, I've been lacking in this area.

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，难怪翳先生会突然发消息过来……
Content.LocalizedString: I see, so that's why you suddenly sent me a message…

Content.SourceString: 下回得买几包番茄酱答谢一下安魂曲了~
Content.LocalizedString: I'll have to buy some packets of tomato jelly to thank Lacrimosa next time!

Content.LocalizedString: happy.jpg

Content.SourceString: 她会很高兴的。
Content.LocalizedString: She'll be delighted.

Content.SourceString: 安魂曲之前的成长环境比较特殊，社交常识相对匮乏，进入异象管理局后，更是没有与外界接触的机会。
Content.LocalizedString: Lacrimosa had a rather unique upbringing, so she lacks social experience. After joining the Bureau of Anomaly Control, she's had even fewer opportunities to interact with the outside world.

Content.SourceString: 她虽然能够辨明善意和恶意，也重视友谊，但对于如何回馈，如何表达，都尚且懵懂，有时会做些难以理解的举动。
Content.LocalizedString: While she can tell good intentions from bad and values friendship, she's still naive about how to reciprocate or express herself properly, which sometimes leads to confusing behavior.

Content.SourceString: 很感谢鉴定师还有伊波恩的诸位，能够成为她的朋友。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm very grateful to you, Appraiser, and everyone at Eibon for becoming her friends.

Content.SourceString: 不必这么说，交友是双向的选择。
Content.LocalizedString: You don't need to say that. Friendship is a choice that goes both ways.

Content.SourceString: 能成为安魂曲和翳先生的朋友，我很高兴。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really happy to become friends with both Lacrimosa and you.

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩里正好有几位和安魂曲差不多年纪的成员，又都是异能者，自然而然就打成一片了。
Content.LocalizedString: Eibon happens to have several members around Lacrimosa's age, and they're all Espers too, so naturally they all clicked right away.

Content.SourceString: 没想到，我也能沾上她的光。
Content.LocalizedString: I never expected that I'd get to benefit from her connections too.

Content.SourceString: 还是感谢你们的体谅。我非常清楚她的破坏力和不稳定性，想必给你们添了不少麻烦。
Content.LocalizedString: I still want to thank you for your understanding. I'm well aware of her destructive potential and instability, and I'm sure she's caused you quite a bit of trouble.

Content.SourceString: 非常荣幸。
Content.LocalizedString: It's truly an honor.

Content.SourceString: 若是将来有什么需要帮忙的，我们会尽力协助。
Content.LocalizedString: If there's anything you need help with in the future, we'll do our best to assist you.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，你好。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 翳先生你好。
Content.LocalizedString: Hello, Skia.

Content.SourceString: 听队员们说，你前段时间比较忙碌，便没有来打扰。
Content.LocalizedString: My team members mentioned you've been quite busy lately, so I didn't want to disturb you.

Content.SourceString: 这段时间确实挺忙的，有各种各样的工作和委托要处理……
Content.LocalizedString: I really have been quite busy lately, with all kinds of work and commissions to handle…

Content.SourceString: 也没有很忙，只是做一些小委托，偶尔赚赚外快。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really not that busy, just doing some small commissions here and there to make a little extra money.

Content.SourceString: 看来，伊波恩的业务比我预想中要繁重一些。
Content.LocalizedString: It seems Eibon's workload is heavier than I anticipated.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师谦虚了。伊波恩处理的委托，在海特洛市的大部分异象猎人看来，可说不上「小」。
Content.LocalizedString: You're being too modest. The commissions that Eibon handles would hardly be considered "small" by most Anomaly Hunters in Hethereau.

Content.SourceString: 说起来……恕我冒昧，关于伊波恩，我一直有个疑问，不知道鉴定师是否方便解答。
Content.LocalizedString: Speaking of which… if you don't mind me asking, I've always had a question about Eibon. Would you be comfortable answering it?

Content.SourceString: 说说看？
Content.LocalizedString: Let's hear it.

Content.SourceString: 作为一支优秀的异象猎人团队，伊波恩的业务能力毋庸置疑，但我有些好奇……
Content.LocalizedString: As an excellent anomaly hunter group, Eibon's capabilities are beyond question, but I'm somewhat curious…

Content.SourceString: 伊波恩的古董生意……如何？
Content.LocalizedString: How is Eibon's antique business… doing?

Content.SourceString: 好残忍的问题……
Content.LocalizedString: Ouch…

Content.SourceString: 生意比较惨淡，基本没什么客人……
Content.LocalizedString: Business is pretty bleak, we barely have any customers…

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，我不是有意的，我也没有任何贬低伊波恩的想法，希望鉴定师不要介怀。
Content.LocalizedString: I apologize, I didn't mean anything by it. I have no intention of disparaging Eibon in any way. I hope you won't take offense, Appraiser.

Content.SourceString: 果然如此。
Content.LocalizedString: I thought so.

Content.SourceString: 翳先生为什么好奇这个？
Content.LocalizedString: Why ask?

Content.SourceString: 只是有一些待验证的猜想。
Content.LocalizedString: Just some theories I'd like to verify.

Content.SourceString: 我出勤常常路过半角街，有时会绕路看一看那家偏僻的古董店，无论在哪个时间段，我似乎都没有看见过几个客人。
Content.LocalizedString: I often pass by Hankaku Street during my patrols, and sometimes I take a detour to check on that secluded antique shop. No matter what time of day it is, I don't think I've ever seen more than a few customers.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Don't tell me you've been watching us…

Content.SourceString: 难道翳先生一直在监视我们……
Content.LocalizedString: Don't tell me you've been watching us this whole time, Skia…

Content.SourceString: 震惊.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: shocked.jpg

Content.SourceString: 当然不是，请鉴定师不要误会，这只是出于我个人的职业习惯。
Content.LocalizedString: Oh, excuse me, of course not. It's simply a matter of personal professional habit.

Content.SourceString: 在加入异象管理局之前，我在莱昂国际工作过，因此对于商铺的选址、经营方面算有些涉猎。
Content.LocalizedString: Before joining the Bureau of Anomaly Control, I worked at Leon International, so I have some experience with shop location and business management.

Content.SourceString: 像是古董店，或者旧物、古着店，又或者其它主营非量产、非实用性质的收藏品的店铺，通常会选址在流量较大的步道或者衍生的小巷。
Content.LocalizedString: Shops like antique stores, vintage or thrift shops, or other businesses that primarily deal in non-mass-produced, non-practical collectibles usually choose locations on high-traffic walkways or the side streets that branch off from them.

Content.SourceString: 我一直都很好奇，伊波恩到底是出于什么目的，才会选址在这么偏僻无人的位置。
Content.LocalizedString: I've always been curious about what purpose Eibon could possibly have for choosing such a remote, deserted location.

OptionText.LocalizedString: Maybe we should ask the boss…

Content.SourceString: 或许得问问浔店长……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe we should ask Hotori…

Content.SourceString: 可能是租金便宜……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe the rent is cheap…

Content.SourceString: 可能是因为这里战略位置隐蔽……
Content.LocalizedString: Maybe it's because this location is strategically hidden…

Content.SourceString: 她是一位值得尊敬的人，或许她有自己的考量。
Content.LocalizedString: She's someone worthy of respect. Perhaps she has her own considerations.

Content.SourceString: 但完全没有客流的话，剩下的租金很快也会被消耗掉……
Content.LocalizedString: But with absolutely no traffic, any rent savings would quickly get eaten up anyway…

Content.SourceString: 还真是相当有分量的考量，是我的思考太狭隘了。
Content.LocalizedString: That's quite a substantial consideration indeed. My thinking is still inside-the-box.

Content.SourceString: 不过考虑到伊波恩作为异象猎人团体，能依靠异象委托业务运转，这个选址或许也算不上什么问题。
Content.LocalizedString: But considering that Eibon operates as an anomaly hunter group and can sustain itself through commissions, the location might not be much of an issue after all.

Content.SourceString: 恕我多管闲事了。
Content.LocalizedString: Forgive my offense.

OptionText.LocalizedString: You can come support our business!

Content.SourceString: 没有的事，翳先生指点得很有道理，不如说我们店长确实需要学习一下店铺经营的常识……
Content.LocalizedString: Not at all, Skia. Your advice was very reasonable. If anything, our shop owner really does need to learn some basic business principles…

Content.SourceString: 翳先生下次路过可以进店里来，最好再照顾照顾我们生意~
Content.LocalizedString: Next time you're passing by, Skia, feel free to come into the shop. It would be great if you could support our business!

Content.SourceString: 指点谈不上，只是闲聊几句罢了。
Content.LocalizedString: I wouldn't call it advice, just casual chat.

Content.SourceString: 发呆.jpg
Content.LocalizedString: dazed.jpg

Content.SourceString: 下回若有机会，我或许可以试着进一次店门。
Content.LocalizedString: If there's an opportunity next time, perhaps I could try stepping inside the shop.

Content.SourceString: 照顾生意……如果是异象委托方面，恐怕由不得我来申请。
Content.LocalizedString: Supporting your business… If it's regarding commissions, I'm afraid I wouldn't have the authority to make such requests.

Content.SourceString: 这家奇特的古董店内部是什么布置和装潢，我还真想见识见识。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm really curious to see what the layout and decor of this peculiar antique shop looks like inside.

Content.SourceString: 但古董收藏，我倒是可以试着接触接触，虽然不了解伊波恩的商品定价大概是什么水平……
Content.LocalizedString: But as for antique collecting, I could try getting into that, though I'm not sure what Eibon's pricing range is like…

Content.SourceString: 翳先生太严肃了！只是邀请你来玩而已！
Content.LocalizedString: You're being too serious! I'm just inviting you to come hang out!

Content.SourceString: 原来如此，那我就恭敬不如从命了。
Content.LocalizedString: I see. Well then, I'd be honored to accept your invitation.

Content.SourceString: 欢迎翳先生来玩！
Content.LocalizedString: Welcome to come visit, Skia!

Content.SourceString: 谢谢你，鉴定师，我非常期待。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you, Appraiser. I'm really looking forward to it.

Content.SourceString: 如果您需要参考的话！我用的是「蓬绒绒尾巴护理喷雾-摩登闪耀猫型特别款」！我马上给您发链接(><``)！
Content.LocalizedString: If you need a reference! I use the Fluffy Tail Care Spray Modern Sparkling Cat Special Edition! I'll send you the link right away(><``)!

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，这是个误会。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, there's been a misunderstanding.

Content.SourceString: 我正在把同事的短讯一条条转发到消息助手，不小心点到你了。
Content.LocalizedString: I was forwarding my colleague's messages one by one to my message assistant, and accidentally clicked on you instead.

OptionText.LocalizedString: I was stunned by that emoticon…

Content.SourceString: 看到第一条消息的符号表情，稍微有点被吓到……
Content.LocalizedString: I was stunned by that emoticon…

Content.SourceString: 这位同事的聊天风格好眼熟……是收容组的同事吧？
Content.LocalizedString: This colleague's chat style seems really familiar… From the Containment Units, right?

Content.SourceString: 是收容组那位很活跃的新人。我没记错的话，你和她应该已经见过了。
Content.LocalizedString: That's the very active rookie from the Containment Units. If I recall correctly, you two should have already met.

Content.SourceString: 是的。看来你和她已经很熟络了。
Content.LocalizedString: Yes. Looks like you two have gotten quite familiar with each other.

Content.SourceString: 这段时间天气有些干燥，Luck干员提醒我，最好花时间做一下毛发的护理和保养。
Content.LocalizedString: The weather's been quite dry lately, so Luck reminded me that I ought to take some time for proper fur care and maintenance.

Content.SourceString: 我不太了解这类产品，就问了一些兽化的异能者同事，让他们推荐一些产品。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm not too familiar with these kinds of products, so I asked some of my animorphic esper colleagues to recommend some options.

Content.SourceString: 薄荷推荐的这款是猫型的，不一定适合你。
Content.LocalizedString: The one Mint recommended is for cats, so it might not be right for you.

Content.SourceString: 有道理，还是你仔细。不过我认识的同事中，的确没有犬型兽化的异能者……
Content.LocalizedString: Right, you're very thorough. Though now that I think about it, none of the colleagues I know are canine animorphic espers…

Content.SourceString: 之前在茶歇时，Luck干员倒是提起过，会在宠物店买犬毛护理用品。或许我可以去考察一下。
Content.LocalizedString: Though during a tea break earlier, Luck did mention that she gets canine grooming products from pet stores. Maybe I should go check it out?

Content.SourceString: 我能来吗？可以给你提提意见。
Content.LocalizedString: Can I come along? I could give you some suggestions.

Content.SourceString: 当然，能有你的意见作为参考，我很放心。
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, having your input as reference would put me at ease.

Content.SourceString: 那晚些时候，在叮咚怪咖所再见。
Content.LocalizedString: Then we'll meet up later at Jingle Wrangle.

Content.SourceString: 那晚些时候，在叮咚怪咖所再见。
Content.LocalizedString: Then we'll meet up later at Jingle Wrangle.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，有件事可能需要请求你的协助，不知道你最近有没有时间谈谈。
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, I've got something I might need your help with. Have a moment to chat sometime soon?

Content.SourceString: 这次并不是异象管理局的事务，是我个人的请求。
Content.LocalizedString: This isn't BAC business. It's a personal request.

Content.SourceString: 能不能先说说，是哪方面的事？
Content.LocalizedString: Could you tell me what this is about?

Content.SourceString: 当然没问题，我怎么帮你？
Content.LocalizedString: Of course, no problem. How can I help you?

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，是我的疏忽，该先和你同步信息。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry for the oversight. I should have briefed you on the details first.

Content.SourceString: 感谢你的信任。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you for your trust.

Content.SourceString: 我正在调查一个涉及异象私密交易的组织，通过一些私人渠道与他们取得了联系，他们同意和我交涉。
Content.LocalizedString: I'm investigating an organization involved in illegal Anomaly trading. I've made contact with them through some private channels, and they've agreed to negotiate with me.

Content.SourceString: 我想借着这次见面，试探一下其交易是否涉及高风险异象。但按照约定，我不能带异象管理局的人。
Content.LocalizedString: I want to use this meeting to probe whether their trading involves high-risk Anomalies. But according to our agreement, I can't bring anyone from the BAC.

Content.SourceString: 如果可以的话，我希望借助你的异能。
Content.LocalizedString: If possible, I'd like to borrow your Esper Ability.

Content.SourceString: 大致情况我了解了，没什么问题。
Content.LocalizedString: I understand the situation. No problem at all.

Content.SourceString: 听上去不难，可以具体聊聊。
Content.LocalizedString: Doesn't sound too difficult. We can discuss the details.

Content.SourceString: 感谢，具体情况我来找你详谈。请稍作等待。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you. I will come to discuss the specific situation with you in detail. Please wait a moment.

Content.SourceString: 感谢，具体情况我来找你详谈。请稍作等待。
Content.LocalizedString: Thank you. I will come to discuss the specific situation with you in detail. Please wait a moment.

Content.SourceString: 鉴定师，现在有空吗？
Content.LocalizedString: Appraiser, are you free right now?

Content.SourceString: 刚好闲下来了，有什么事吗？
Content.LocalizedString: I've got some time now. What's up?

Content.SourceString: 抱歉，暂时没空，不过你可以先说说你的事。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, I'm tied up at the moment, but go ahead and tell me what's up.

Content.SourceString: 是关于之前说过的异象调查报告。我想尝试找出圣阿尔博镇更明确的历史。
Content.LocalizedString: It's about the Anomaly Investigation Report we talked about earlier. I want to try to piece together a clearer history of St. Arbor.

Content.SourceString: 所以想问问，你还记得那是什么时候的事情吗？
Content.LocalizedString: So I wanted to ask you… do you remember when that happened?

OptionText.LocalizedString: So that's what this is about.

Content.SourceString: 原来是这个啊。很抱歉，我也不知道，我只知道那个镇子在被异象侵凌前，已经存在了266年。
Content.LocalizedString: Sorry, but I don't know much either. All I know is that the town had already been around for 266 years before the Anomaly Encroachment.

Content.SourceString: 好吧，看来这份异象报告只能保持现在的样子提交了。
Content.LocalizedString: Gotcha, looks like this Anomaly Report is going out as-is.

Content.SourceString: 这样也好，薄荷听说了这次的异象事件后，就一直说想要借阅学习。
Content.LocalizedString: Don't worry about it. Ever since Mint heard about this Anomaly case, she's been saying she wants to borrow the report and study it.

Content.SourceString: 按照规定，调查报告不能随意带出异象管理局，这份报告这么厚，薄荷可要在办公室苦读很久了。
Content.LocalizedString: By the book, investigation reports can't just be taken out of the Bureau. With one this thick, Mint's going to be stuck in the office reading it for quite a while.
